title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Ava Chen
description:
Summary: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning at the controller level and improve audit logging for KMS and residency-related policy decisions. Motivation: customers running Private/Dedicated deployments need deterministic KMS residency enforcement and richer audit trails for compliance. This PR closes gaps where policy checks were advisory (audit-only) and adds an enforcement mode that rejects non-compliant creates/updates.

What changed (single continuous string):
- Enforced KMS region pinning: controller validates that resources (key references, secrets, and workspace configs) are pinned to allowed regions per RBAC v2 policies. Previously the policy could be set to audit-only; this adds an enforcement mode that rejects non-compliant creates/updates.
- Audit logging enhancements: added structured audit entries for KMS decisions including policy id, policy mode (audit/enforce), requested_region, resolved_region, effected_resource, and decision_reason. Logs are emitted to the existing audit pipeline and include trace/span IDs when available.
- Migration path: new cluster roles and default policies are added; an opt-in feature flag (security.kms.regionPinning.enforce) is required to flip enforcement in running clusters to avoid accidental rejections. We emit warnings during rollout and provide a migration script that converts audit-only policies to enforce after operator sign-off.
- Tests and CI: unit tests for controller validation, integration tests simulating cross-region KMS references, and e2e test that runs with enforcement enabled in a sandbox.
- Docs and release notes: updated operational docs with roll-forward instructions and remediation steps for common failures.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller validation logic implemented
- [x] Audit entry schema and pipeline integration
- [x] Migration script + rollback plan
- [x] Unit/integration/e2e tests
- [x] Docs & release notes

Notes on behavior and risk:
- Default behavior remains audit-only; enforcement is gated behind the feature flag to allow staged rollout.
- Enforcement will return 403s for create/update requests that violate region pinning when enabled. We added clear error messages with policy id and remediation hints.
- There is a small performance cost (~2-4ms median per policy check) measured in internal perf runs; this is acceptable given security guarantees and can be tuned in follow-ups with caching.

Migration instructions (operators):
1. Install new controller image (this PR) to staging clusters.
2. Run `scripts/migrate-audit-to-enforce.py --preview` to get an impact report.
3. Fix outstanding non-compliant resources or add explicit allow-exceptions.
4. Flip feature flag: `security.kms.regionPinning.enforce=true` and monitor audit logs and rollout dashboards.

Related: ENG-4321 (policy enforcement work), SEC-210 (audit schema standardization), SUP-987 (customer report of ambiguous audit logs).

review_comments: Ravi Patel (review): Please add a migration preview tool so operators can understand impact before flipping enforcement. Also include clear error codes for audit logs.
Ava Chen (reply): Added tools/migrate-audit-to-enforce.py with --preview; audit entries include 'policy_id' and 'decision_code' fields. Updated PR description.
Sofia Morales (review): Audit entries should include trace/span IDs where available so SRE can correlate with traces. Also, ensure log size is bounded for high-volume tenants.
Ava Chen (reply): Included trace/span ID field and switch to include only the first 256 chars of the resource context to bound log size. Added unit tests for log size trimming.
Diego Ramirez (review): Integration tests look good. Question: what happens for legacy KMS references that omit region?

Ava Chen (reply): Controller resolves keys via the resolver: if region cannot be determined, validation returns 'undetermined' and, when enforcement is enabled, rejects with clear remediation. Added docs on adding explicit region tags to legacy keys.
merge_commit_message:
Enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements

- Controller validation for KMS region pinning
- Structured audit entries for KMS decisions
- Migration tooling and docs
- Tests and CI updates
release_notes: Added enforcement mode for RBAC v2 KMS region pinning (opt-in via feature flag).
Audit logs now include structured fields for policy decisions (policy_id, decision_code, requested_region, resolved_region, trace_id).
Migration tool available to preview impact before enabling enforcement.
Improved error messages for policy rejections with remediation hints.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag security.kms.regionPinning.enforce=false by default. Use migration script to preview impact. Watch policy-enforcement dashboard and audit pipeline for policy rejections after enabling enforcement.
